pr_title: changefeedccl: support for multiple seed brokers in kafka v2 sink
pr_body:
Previously the kafka v2 sink did not support multiple seed brokers, where the v1 sink did. This PR adds this support.

Fixes: #136616

Release note (general change): add support for multiple seed brokers in the new kafka sink.

issue_context.title: changefeedccl: unable to specify multiple kafka brokers for the v2 sink
issue_context.body:
The v2 sink fails if you specify multiple kafka brokers in your create changefeed statement, and the feed is not created: 

```
> CREATE CHANGEFEED FOR TABLE t2 INTO 'kafka://localhost:9092,localhost:9092'
ERROR: unable to dial: dial tcp: lookup localhost:9092,localhost:9092: no such host
```

This works with the v1 sink.


Jira issue: CRDB-45165
